name: Burr
description: The pan's mid-tier wave body, and the one that is ranged by dying: the game throws five of its spines outward when it is killed within reach of the player (EnemyType.deathShots). So it is drawn as the thing it sheds — a dark chitin ball with ten husk spines radiating off it on their own roots, a plate of lighter shell and a lit organ on the back, a small head at +x with mandibles, six stubs under. The silhouette is a star, and nothing else in the roster is one. Seen from above, facing +x, mirrored by the game. Gameplay radius 10. `elite` is the bleached, heavier version the stage-6 marking wears, with longer bone spines. The `death` clip is the mechanic drawn: every spine travels out along its own root and fades while the ball deflates under them.

elite.description: Marked by the hive: bleached shell, longer bone spines, a brighter organ.

trundle.description: six stubs walk in tripods under a ball that rocks on the step; every spine shivers on its own root and the mandibles work

death.description: the spines leave — each travels out along its own root and fades, which is what the game throws five of for real — while the ball under them deflates, the stubs fold in, the mandibles fall open and the organ goes out
